data.title: T3 Defense Enters the UAV and Counter-UAV (C-UAV) Platform Market
data.description: The technology company T3 has introduced new mobile platforms through its subsidiary Rimon for both drone and counter-drone operations. This development offers enhanced capabilities for operating drones and countering unauthorized drone activities. The mobile platforms are designed to provide efficient solutions in this field, catering to a growing demand for such technologies. The introduction of these platforms reflects T3's commitment to innovation and adaptation in the ever-evolving drone industry. With this launch, T3 aims to address the needs of drone operators and counter-drone units, optimizing their operations in safeguarding airspace.

data.title: SharkNinja Conjures Ninja SLUSHi Twist x Practical Magic 2 Collection
data.description: In Needham, Massachusetts, SharkNinja Inc. (NYSE: SN), a renowned global technology and product design company, is introducing four exclusive Ninja® SLUSHi® Twist x Practical Magic 2 color variations in specially curated packaging. This launch commemorates the upcoming release of the movie on September 10, 2026, in cinemas. The sequel showcases the original Ninja SLUSHi aiding the Owens sisters in revamping their famed "Midnight Margaritas." Ninja is embracing this collaboration by extending the memorable scene from the film, offering fans a chance to immerse themselves beyond the movie theater.

data.title: NFT LTD Announces Pricing of US$2.0 Million Public Offering
data.description: Today in Hong Kong, NFT Ltd. (NYSE American: MI), formerly known as Takung Art Co., Ltd., a growing online trading platform for international art and collectibles, disclosed the pricing of its registered offering. The company is offering 437,957 units at US$4.60 per Unit on a best efforts basis, resulting in a total value of approximately US$2,012,937.20 for the Offering. This move is aimed at attracting investors and expanding the company's presence in the global market as it rebrands and focuses on facilitating online trades in valuable items.

data.title: BJ’s Wholesale Club Continues Texas Expansion with New Location Planned for Tyler
data.description: BJ’s Wholesale Club (BJ) has revealed intentions to establish a new location in Tyler, Texas, as part of its expansion strategy following its recent entry into the Dallas-Fort Worth region. This move is aligned with BJ’s plan to open 25-30 new clubs every two years as part of their growth strategy. The company emphasizes its commitment to providing value, citing over 40 years of delivering savings and convenience to families.

data.title: The Atlantic hasn't seen any hurricanes this year but it's unclear if the calm will last. Consider flood insurance.
data.description: So far this year, there have been no hurricanes forming in the Atlantic basin, which is below the average number usually seen by this time. However, experts warn that the current low activity is not guaranteed to persist throughout the rest of the hurricane season.

data.title: Tesla, Waymo, Uber Granted Las Vegas Robotaxi Permits
data.description: Regulators in Nevada have officially granted permits for robotaxi services in Las Vegas to Tesla, Uber, and Google's Waymo, in addition to Amazon's Zoox. This decision, made on Thursday, allows these companies to operate autonomous vehicles in the city. The approval marks a significant milestone in the advancement of self-driving technology, with Tesla, Waymo, and Uber now poised to offer their services alongside Zoox in Las Vegas. This news has been covered by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Ross Stores Trounces Earnings, Set To Retake Buy Point
data.description: Shares of Ross Stores surged by 8% following an outstanding quarter that exceeded expectations on Wall Street. The company reported strong earnings, fueled by tariff refunds. This performance has positioned Ross Stores to potentially reclaim its buy point.
